run.trigger: Operations asked the agent to work this case

steps.summary: Bentley Continental GT for Norvessia Autotalot, Seinäjoki → Turku. Driver Alex Forvelin (in progress).
5 recent messages. Latest from Support desk: “Thank you. We will review both sets of evidence and return with what can actually be established.”
1 open alert (Review post delivery condition for CD-420055; source is a conversation, not a verified outcome.), no incidents, no open tasks.
Last driver-app position 27 min ago (coarse), 237 km to go.
no bookings; no quote or capacity checks (not bookings).

input.purpose: Quick check on the Bentley you are moving today, because there is a question about a mark on the car.
questions: Do you have the Bentley Continental GT with you now, and where did you collect it this morning?
At pickup, did you see or photograph any mark on the left rear of the car?
Are your pickup photos uploaded in the app?
Where are you now and are you okay to keep driving?

steps.summary: Simulated call Alex Forvelin. Yes, I have the Bentley Continental GT with me now, and I collected it this morning from the pickup address in Seinäjoki on order CD-420055. I took photos all around the car at pickup, but I don't remember noticing a mark on the left rear, so I'd need to…

input.text: Sources disagree on where the car is. The customer says the Bentley "arrived" with a left rear mark, but Alex Forvelin says they have the car now, collected in Seinäjoki this morning and on the way to Turku. The order shows as delivered after the 16 Oct leg but also has a leg in progress today. It is not clear which handover the claim is about.
input.source_label: Support chat vs driver call vs order record

input.text: Alex Forvelin took photos all around the car at pickup this morning and doesn't remember a mark on the left rear. They think the photos uploaded but haven't checked.

The driver says they are about halfway to Turku. The app last showed 27% done with 237 km left, 27 minutes ago, coarse position only. The app's arrival estimate is 22 Oct 12:00, which is before the requested delivery window of 23 Oct 11:00–16:00. The Turku contact, Gemma Briarmere, has not confirmed they can take the car.

The customer has sent two photos of the left rear mark from the receiving partner. They cannot say when the mark was first noticed. The earlier proposal to blame the delivery driver was rejected. The evidence comparison is still waiting for review.

input.title: Support to compare photos and confirm which handover the mark claim is about
input.rationale: The customer says the car arrived with a left rear mark, but the driver has the car now on its way to Turku. Someone has to sort out which handover the claim means and compare the photos before anyone is blamed. The driver can stop and photograph the left rear while still on the road.

changes.label: Evidence comparison
changes.after: Support compares the 15 Oct pickup and 16 Oct delivery photos (Oliver Karvenby), today's pickup photos (Alex Forvelin) and the customer's two photos

draft_message.body: CD-420055 Bentley. The customer says the car 'arrived' with a left rear mark (two photos, no time given). But Alex Forvelin collected it in Seinäjoki this morning and is driving it to Turku now (app estimate 22 Oct 12:00). 1) Check whether Alex's pickup photos uploaded (the driver hasn't confirmed). Compare them with Oliver Karvenby's 15/16 Oct photos and the customer's photos. 2) In the reply already promised to the customer, ask which handover and place they mean. Send it only through an approved message. 3) If you want a fresh close-up of the left rear before Turku, ask Alex to stop safely and take one; they offered. Don't blame anyone yet. Also, Gemma Briarmere in Turku still hasn't confirmed they can take the car on 23 Oct.

input.what_happens_next: The case goes to the support desk. I will not contact the customer or ask the driver to stop.
input.what_happens_after: The support desk owns the claim. They are comparing the photos and checking which handover the customer means.
